title: Gowers–Long 2-increasing triples conjecture
statement: Every 2-increasing sequence of triples from {1,…,n}³ has length at most n^(3/2), where each earlier triple is strictly smaller than each later triple in at least two coordinates.

counterexample.description: An n and an explicit ordered sequence of more than n^(3/2) triples in [n]³ satisfying the 2-increasing condition for every earlier-later pair.
